title: The Space Between
description:
The space between is less about what's seen and more about what is not. It is about solitude, serendipity, and peace, not that which lives just outside the frame.

I seek moments far from the shouting and the spin. I don't use the camera to reveal, promote, proselytize, or incite. I make images that leave room to reflect. To remember or discover a life free from the noise.

A quiet space. The space between.
